title: Cluster-Cluster model in $\mathbb{Z}^d$
summary: We consider a stochastic process on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ for $d \geq 1$. Given a translation invariant and ergodic starting configuration of finite clusters, each cluster $C$ performs a continuous time simple random walk with rate $|C|^{-α}$. If it attempts to move to a vertex occupied by another cluster, it does not move, and instead the two clusters connect via a new edge. In all dimensions, we show that if $α\ge 0$, there is almost surely no spontaneous creation of an infinite cluster within finite time.
